page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head top centre, page number top right. Top: one running paragraph continuing from the previous page. Below it: a large ornamental woodcut initial with a caption beside it on the right ("Ad Mandatum Cæsar. Majest. proprium."). Then the signature "S. Westner" with "st." beneath it. Then the centred address (large type), the sender's title line (larger type), and the opening of the letter, which starts with a woodcut initial and runs to the foot of the page.

main_text.p: arbeit für uns zu nemmen/darzu wir dich gebrauchen wollen/wolten wir dir gnediger meinung nie [?] verhalten/der gnedigen zuversicht/du werdest in demselben auch deinen besten fleiß fürkeren/das alles wollen wir in sondern gnaden gegen dir erkennen. Geben in unser Statt Inßbruck/ am neun und zweintzigsten Martij. Anno ꝛc. XVIII. Unsers Reichs im XXXII. jahre.
main_text.head: An unsern und des Reichs lieben getreuen / Bilibaldum Pirckeymer / unsern Rath:
Maximilian von Gottes Gnaden/erwelter Römischer Keyser ꝛc.
main_text.p: Lieber getreuer / wir haben die Lauream, so du uns vor kurtz verschienen tagen zugeschickt hast/

page.notes: The large woodcut initials (the "P" of the decorative block and the "L" opening the letter) are printed ornaments; the initial letter of the letter is joined to its word as "Lieber". The "Ad Mandatum" caption is printed in italic beside the ornament. The word "nie" in the top paragraph is doubtful and marked [?]. The signature "st." under "S. Westner" is not clearly legible. Printed spelling kept, including "Lauream" and "zweintzigsten". Long s rendered as s; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules.
